visualCharacteristics.structure: intro (h3 + copy + Add to project pill) and a scroll-snap slider of room images with prev/next buttons, current room name and 01/05 counter
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked by default; premium option: intro in columns 1-3 and slider in columns 5-12 from 1024px. Images 2:3 on mobile, 3:2 on desktop

contentPattern: Row 1: [h3 + p intro] (single cell, detected as the first row without a picture). Rows 2..n: [picture | room name]. Reads rgbhex, color-code, color-name metadata.
